title: Agentic Workflow Step
description: Minimal schema for multi-step agent workflows. Step-to-step traceability is achieved via optional parent_step_id linking each step to its direct predecessor.

workflow_id.description: Unique identifier for the workflow run; all steps in the same run share this value.

step_id.description: Unique identifier of this step within the workflow.

parent_step_id.description: Optional: step_id of the direct parent step to form the execution chain/graph.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool or action invoked at this step.

input_summary.description: Description of the inputs or prompt for this step.

output_summary.description: Description of the outputs/results produced by this step.

duration_ms.description: End-to-end runtime of the step in milliseconds (non-negative).

error.description: Error object required when status is 'failed' or 'timeout'.

message.description: Human-readable error message explaining the failure/timeout.
